title: Malaad bi
intro: Bu yàgg, ci jamonoy taarixu doomi aadama yi, ñaari ruuh ñoo taxawoon ci kanamu seen Boroom, yóbbaale sarax. Benn nangu nañu ko, beneen nangu wuñu ko. Li ci topp mooy doon musiiba bu njëkk bi diggante ay mbokk- benn jëf buy tëye ak beneen jëf buy fayyu bu metti. Ndax mën nga wane ki ma doon?
clues: Dama judd ci bis yi nit ñi njëkka am ci kaw suuf
Man maay doomu jëkkër ak jabar yi njëkka dox ci kaw suuf
Mas naa def sarax bu gën ci sama gétt ngir neexal sama Boroom .
Sama sarax nangu nañu ko ci kaw, waaye saraxu sama mbokk nangu nañu ko
Bi ñu ma wax ni dina ñu ma ray, dama tànn baña yëkkati sama loxo ci sama mbokk.
Ci taarixu doomi aadama yi, man maa njëkka nekk ki keneen ray ci lu jaarul yoon.

options: Mooy ki ñu njëkka ray ci taarixu doomi aadama yi

Dafa jiite jinne yi, nit ñi ak ngelaw li
Doxantu ñeent-fukki at ci àll bu yaatu
outcome.answer: Mooy ki ñu njëkka ray ci taarixu doomi aadama yi

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
